title: Displaced water: a model ship (অপসারিত পানি: জাহাজের মডেল)
placement: Book page 137, topic 5.3.1 আর্কিমিডিসের নীতি এবং প্লবতা: the sentence 'কোনো বস্তু তরলে নিমজ্জিত করলে সেটি যে পরিমাণ তরল অপসারণ করে সেইটুকু তরলের সমান ওজন বস্তুটির ওজন থেকে কমে যায়' and F = Vρg, shown with a model ship in an overflow can; beside buoyancy-ship.
description: Displaced water with a toy cargo ship (page 137, topic 5.3.1, with page 138's 5.3.2), beside buoyancy-ship. On a plain sand table in a calm deep-blue setting: a clear glass tank filled to the lip of its spout (an overflow can), a low glass beaker with printed cm³ marks under the spout on a digital kitchen scale, and a toy cargo ship (buoyancy-ship's ship in its colours, 22 cm long, a prism hull of waterline area A = 100 cm²) hanging by four cords from a digital hanging scale on a lab stand; six toy containers of 50 g on the table. Four steps, one tap each. ওজন: both scales come on: the ship 200 g, the empty beaker 0 g (W = mg = 1.96 N). নামাও: the stand's arm slides down; as the hull goes under, the hanging scale reads less and exactly that much water runs out of the spout into the beaker (a thin stream), until the scale reads 0 g and the ship floats with 200 g of water in the beaker: the book's sentence that a body loses as much weight as the liquid it pushes aside. The arm can then be dragged both ways: lifting the ship lowers the water in the tank and the spilled water stays in the beaker (the tank's water is tracked as a volume, nothing fudged). প্লবতা: the cords are unhooked; ওজন W (violet, down) and প্লবতা F (orange, up) on the floating ship, equal; V = 200 cm³ in the beaker, m = Vρ = 200 g, F = Vρg = 1.96 N. বোঝাই: each tap lifts a container onto the deck; the ship settles 0.5 cm deeper and exactly 50 g more water runs out; two bars, ship + cargo and the water pushed aside, stay equal; V = Ah with the draft h read on the hull's draft marks, up to the load line at six. A calm intro card; per step a lead-in, the result and the book's words; the kit's how-to row and 360° view. Test: 4 questions read off the picture (the hanging scale's reading from the beaker's, what carries a floating ship, one more container, the buoyancy in newtons), every wrong choice a real mistake with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
